name: content-saas
description: SaaS de automacao de conteudo com IA, Supabase, BullMQ e render de previews.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @content-saas/contracts && npm run build -w @content-saas/supabase && npm run build -w @content-saas/render && npm run build -w @content-saas/orchestrator && npm run build -w @content-saas/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @content-saas/contracts && npm run build -w @content-saas/supabase && npm run typecheck -w @content-saas/render && npm run typecheck -w @content-saas/orchestrator && npm run typecheck -w @content-saas/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @content-saas/contracts && npm run test -w @content-saas/supabase && npm run test -w @content-saas/render && npm run test -w @content-saas/orchestrator && npm run test -w @content-saas/web
